description:
Merged ad-control patch based on Nai64's No Ads patch, with selectable SDK/ad-format blocking
and optional literal-host filters inspired by Entree and Adobo. Filters are embedded,
toggleable subsets; they affect literal hosts only, not dynamically generated or encrypted
traffic or requests made entirely inside Google Play services.

Compatibility: when combined with Disable Forced Online Checks, keep that patch's “Exclude
ad SDK and networking code” option enabled; otherwise blocked ad hosts may be treated as
online and retried. PairIP Firebase cleanup/removal can disable Firebase-backed reward,
sign-in, billing, and attribution flows, which this patch cannot restore.

This patch includes an optional Universal Overlay addon. To use the addon, patch Ads Block Patch
together with Universal Overlay and select one or both of its overlay addon modules:
“Block Ads” and “Block Ads / Tracking Hosts”. Ad runtime policy is
enabled automatically when at least one of these Ads runtime modules is enabled in patch
settings. The selected modules
appear under “Ad control hook modules” in Universal Overlay when selected. Host blocking
starts according to the Enable Block Ads / Tracking Hosts master setting. Universal Overlay is required for the runtime policy to be
installed; if it is not selected, the normal static ad controls still work but these
runtime addon modules are not available.
Runtime changes last for the current app process and affect only methods and literal hosts
successfully instrumented by this patch. Its policy is attached to the selected overlay's
own startup bridge, including a manual Activity override; it does not independently choose
an Application or Activity. Native, dynamically generated, unsupported, or unrecognized
SDK paths remain unchanged.

Credits: Nai64Patches from Nai64; host-blocking approach inspired by Entree and Adobo.
name: Ads Block Patch ( Experimental, Enhanced, Overlay Support, UniManager Support )

description:
Customizes APK install identity and launcher presentation. Name, icon, hide-icon, and Clone
are independent; Clone enables side-by-side install. This cannot preserve original-app data when a package or signing identity
changes. Clone mode rewrites supported manifest identifiers only; it does not rewrite
bytecode strings, explicit process names, task affinities, or arbitrary SDK configuration.
A clone has a new Android package identity and normally a new signing identity: package- or
certificate-bound OAuth, Firebase, Google Play Games, billing, deep links, and server
licenses may therefore not work and cannot be repaired safely by this patch. If PairIP
Bypass is also enabled, server/package-bound PairIP enforcement can still reject the clone.

Inspired by Nai64Patches from Nai64: Clone, Custom App Icon, and Hide App Icon patches.
The optional Preserve App Data After Uninstall setting applies Android's fragile-user-data
and backup compatibility flags. It does not guarantee data retention, and it cannot carry
data from the original package into a clone with a different package identity.
For target SDK compatibility, use Improve Legacy App / Game Compatibility for Modern
Android Patch. Keeping target SDK handling there avoids duplicate manifest changes.
name: Custom App Output Patch (Experimental, Enhanced)

options.description: Create a side-by-side install by changing the manifest package name. Disabled by default. This does not bypass app signatures or preserve original-app data. Package/certificate-bound OAuth, Firebase, Google Play Games, billing, deep links, and server licenses may stop working; PairIP cannot reliably bypass server package checks on a clone.

options.description: Append adds a suffix to the original package, such as com.example.app.u. Complete replace uses the Package name override exactly as entered.
options.title: Advanced > Clone for side-by-side install > Package name mode

options.description: Suffix used by Append mode. Use one or more lowercase package segments, for example .u, .clone, or .patched.test. A leading dot is added automatically when omitted.
options.title: Advanced > Clone for side-by-side install > Append package suffix

options.description: Complete replacement package name used only in Complete replace mode, for example com.example.mycopy. Leave empty when using Append mode.
options.title: Advanced > Clone for side-by-side install > Package name override

options.description: Update ContentProvider authorities that begin with the original package. This avoids common side-by-side install conflicts.
options.title: Advanced > Clone compatibility > Rewrite provider authorities

options.description: Update app-defined permission names and matching uses-permission entries that begin with the original package.
options.title: Advanced > Clone compatibility > Rewrite custom permissions

options.description: Expand relative Activity, Service, Receiver, Provider, and alias class names to the original package before cloning. This prevents Android from searching for classes in the new package.
options.title: Advanced > Clone compatibility > Preserve relative components

options.description: Ask Android to preserve app data when uninstalling and offer it for restoration on reinstall. This is best-effort, may be affected by Android version and backup policy, and cannot preserve data across a changed clone package identity.
options.title: Advanced > App data compatibility > Preserve App Data After Uninstall

options.description: Name shown in the home launcher. It updates the application label and launcher activities or aliases. Leave empty to keep the original name.

options.description: Replace the application and all Activity or Activity-alias icon attributes with your supplied image. Ignored when Hide launcher icon is enabled.
options.title: Quick setup > Launcher presentation > Use custom icon

options.description: Local PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WebP file. A square image with transparent padding is recommended. This source takes priority over String Handler.
options.title: Quick setup > Launcher presentation > Icon local image

options.description: Fallback icon source when Local image is empty: a raw Base64 image string, data:image/...;base64,..., or an HTTPS image URL. Example Base64 input: <base64 string here>. You can encode an image at https://base64.guru/converter/encode/image.

description:

server-side login, entitlement, multiplayer, or game-state checks.

Compatibility: Ads Block Patch can intentionally block ad hosts. Keep “Exclude ad SDK and
networking code” enabled when both patches are selected so blocked ads are not falsely told
the device is online and repeatedly retried. This does not bypass server-enforced online play.

options.title: Compatibility > Exclude ad SDK and networking code

description:
Embeds Frida Gadget and selected JavaScript in an APK. Extra scripts load in order; an empty
entry leaves the APK unchanged. Minimal Footprint Mode disables script file watching; it is not stealth.

Warning : This patch has the potential to modify internals of patched APK at runtime depending on given JavaScript files, but is also detectable! Use this patch at your own risk.
name: Embed Frida Gadget ( Advanced )

options.description: Optional Frida Gadget .so or .so.xz file. Leave empty to fetch the latest official matching Gadget during patching with SHA-256 verification.
options.title: Frida Gadget > Gadget file input

options.description: Disable script file watching and keep runtime behavior minimal. This is compatibility-focused, not stealth or anti-detection behavior.
options.title: Frida Gadget > Minimal Footprint Mode

options.description: Required UTF-8 JavaScript file selected through Morphe Manager. It is embedded and loaded first. Leave empty to skip this patch entirely.
options.title: Frida Gadget > Scripts > Entry / First JavaScript file

options.description: Optional patch-time paths, one per row. No artificial path-count limit. Exact final .js files are embedded in order; invalid paths are skipped and processing continues.
options.title: Frida Gadget > Scripts > Additional JavaScript files

description:
Improves older app and game compatibility on modern Android with manifest, storage, screen,
native runtime, network, shared-library, device-identity, and OpenIAB receiver controls.
Spoof Target SDK may help installation or launch, but cannot repair incompatible code.

Use Control Embedded Auth / Stores Patch for Google Play license or Google Play Services checks;
these options stay separate to prevent overlapping injections.

This patch cannot restore shut-down servers, missing CPU architecture support, server licensing,
Play Integrity, or unsupported native code. Conservative compatibility features are enabled by
default; more invasive native, network, storage, library, and identity options remain disabled.

Experimental: Its functionalities are not guaranteed to work in all apps.

Credits: Nai64Patches from Nai64 for the original legacy compatibility functionality. Hidden API
bypass uses AndroidHiddenApiBypass by LSPosed (Apache-2.0). UniPatches
provides the merged settings, validation, manifest safeguards, compatibility organization, and provides suppress GPlay Login UI patch option.
name: Improve Legacy App / Game Compatibility for Modern Android Patch ( Experimental, Enhanced )

options.description: Report a compatible target SDK so older apps can install or launch on modern Android. This may change platform behavior and does not repair incompatible code. Explicit opt-in is required because lowering an app's target SDK can weaken platform protections.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Spoof Target SDK

options.description: Target SDK value used by the Custom profile. Values outside 23..40 are rejected. Default: 34.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Target SDK version

options.description: Custom uses the Target SDK version value above. Automatic uses target 27 for apps originally below 30 and the custom value otherwise. Target 27 or Target 29 are fixed legacy profiles. This does not repair incompatible code.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Target SDK compatibility profile

options.description: Enable selected manifest compatibility declarations for older apps. The sub-options apply only when this feature is enabled.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Legacy App Reviver

options.description: When Legacy App Reviver is enabled, add org.apache.http.legacy as an optional shared library for old HttpClient users.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Apache HTTP legacy library

options.description: When Legacy App Reviver is enabled, declare FOREGROUND_SERVICE for older background-service apps.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Foreground service permission

options.description: When Legacy App Reviver is enabled, declare SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM. Android may still require user approval; enable only for apps that schedule exact alarms.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Exact alarm permission

options.description: When Legacy App Reviver is enabled, declare modern Bluetooth permissions. Declarations do not grant runtime access.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Bluetooth permissions

options.description: Automatic applies the fix only when the exact OpenIAB UnityPlugin call, receiver ownership, resolvable IntentFilter actions, recognized internal or external-store action set, and safe register layout are confirmed. It uses NOT_EXPORTED for internal receivers and EXPORTED only for verified external-store broadcasts; unknown or mixed actions are skipped. Disabled leaves OpenIAB unchanged. Force applies the exact method fix for troubleshooting and may affect external billing broadcasts. Automatic is recommended.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Runtime compatibility > Fix OpenIAB dynamic receiver registration

options.description: Exempt all hidden non-SDK interfaces for this app on Android 9 and newer, so old apps using reflection on framework internals keep working. Applies at app startup; affects only this app's process. Explicit opt-in is required because this weakens Android's non-SDK API boundary.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Runtime compatibility > Bypass Hidden API Restrictions

options.description: Security risk: disables TLS certificate and hostname validation for HttpsURLConnection traffic, allowing man-in-the-middle interception. Only enable for legacy apps whose servers use expired or self-signed certificates. WebView traffic is not covered. A separate acknowledgement is required.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Runtime compatibility > Trust All Certificates

options.description: Explicitly acknowledge that trust-all TLS is a high-risk, process-wide override. Trust All Certificates is ignored unless this acknowledgement is enabled too.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Runtime compatibility > Acknowledge Trust-All TLS Risk

options.description: Rewrite direct Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory and getExternalStoragePublicDirectory calls to app-scoped directories so games and apps writing to storage root no longer crash or lose saves. This can break code that builds shared-storage or OBB paths from the returned root; use only when intended and keep it disabled for apps using conventional OBB paths.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Runtime compatibility > Redirect Legacy External Storage Paths

options.description: Wrap every Context.registerReceiver call that has no receiver flags with a runtime branch passing RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED on Android 13 and newer. Without it, apps targeting SDK 33+ crash at registration. System broadcasts still reach NOT_EXPORTED receivers, but custom broadcasts sent by other apps may no longer arrive. OpenIAB classes are left to the dedicated OpenIAB option.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Runtime compatibility > Fix Dynamic Receiver Registrations (App Wide)

options.description: Add missing android:exported values to activities, aliases, services, and receivers that have intent filters. Do NOT enable this together with Export All Activities because they overlap. If both are selected accidentally, Export All Activities takes precedence. Explicit opt-in is required because exported components expand the app's attack surface.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Repair Missing Component Export Flags

options.description: Set android:exported=true on every activity and activity-alias. Do NOT enable this together with Repair Missing Component Export Flags because they overlap. If both are selected accidentally, this option takes precedence.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Export All Activities

options.description: Allow HTTP traffic through android:usesCleartextTraffic. Existing networkSecurityConfig is preserved and may continue restricting cleartext traffic.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Allow Cleartext Traffic

options.description: Mark required uses-library entries as optional so missing shared libraries do not block installation. The app may still crash if it actually requires a library.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Relax Shared Libraries

options.description: Declare QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES so old apps can detect the Play Store and other installed apps on Android 11 and newer instead of receiving NameNotFoundException.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Bypass Package Visibility

options.description: Enable android:largeHeap (bigger heap for old games) and android:hardwareAccelerated (fixes blank screens in apps that disabled GPU rendering; may conflict with software-drawing apps).
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Installation and manifest > Extra Manifest Compatibility Attributes

options.description: Request the Android 10 legacy shared-storage model and add WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE if absent. Android 11 and newer may ignore this setting.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Storage and display > Legacy External Storage

options.description: Optional main.<versionCode>.<package>.obb source. Leave empty unless APK startup expects a missing Play expansion file.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Unity/OBB > Expansion OBB file

options.description: Copy assets/libs/<abi>/*.so entries from the selected OBB into APK lib/<abi>/ paths. Use when Unity/Mono native libraries are incomplete or misplaced in the OBB.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Unity/OBB > Relocate full native libraries from OBB

options.description: When native-library relocation and OBB embedding are both enabled, omit relocated assets/libs/<abi>/*.so entries from the embedded OBB without changing the source file.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Unity/OBB > Remove relocated native libraries from embedded OBB

options.description: Embed selected OBB as an APK asset and stage it into Android's conventional OBB directory before app startup. Large APK growth and external-storage policy limits still apply.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Unity/OBB > Embed and stage expansion OBB

options.description: Move the launcher filter from com.google.android.vending.expansion.downloader_impl.DownloaderActivity to the known Unity launcher. Requires Embed and stage expansion OBB.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Unity/OBB > Bypass expansion downloader launcher

options.description: Remove compatible-screens restrictions and mark common screen sizes and densities as supported.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Storage and display > Support All Screens

options.description: Set android:extractNativeLibs=true for old native loaders that cannot execute compressed APK libraries. This increases installed storage use.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Native runtime > Extract native libraries

options.description: Disable native heap pointer tagging for older native apps that fail under newer Android memory behavior.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Native runtime > Disable Heap Pointer Tagging

options.description: Disable selected VM AOT/JIT optimizations for compatibility. This can reduce performance.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Native runtime > VM Safe Mode

options.description: Replace recognized TelephonyManager IMEI getter results. This is limited to matching bytecode calls.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Device compatibility > Spoof IMEI

options.description: Exactly 15 digits used when Spoof IMEI is enabled. Invalid values are rejected.
options.title: Legacy App Compatibility > Device compatibility > IMEI value
